name: wise0855
label: WISE 0855
method: aperture photometry r=2 px, sky ring 4-7 px; Gaia neighbours within 15" fitted together
note: 256 measurements, one per SPHEREx photo; 51 flagged (1 overloaded: the star is too bright for the camera there); 255 deblended from a neighbouring Gaia star; error bars widened x1.1 to match the real scatter.

variability.text: no change beyond the uncertainty (steady within about 13%)
